name: GT's Synergy Raw Kombucha Trilogy (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Raw, unpasteurized fermented tea containing live wild bacteria, active yeasts, organic acetic acids, and natural effervescence. In patients on immunosuppressive biologics (e.g., anti-TNF, anti-IL-12/23) or with raw ulcerated mucosa, unpasteurized cultures pose real opportunistic risks alongside severe acid irritation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID, especially if taking biologic therapies, steroids, or immunomodulators. Do not consume raw fermented unpasteurized drinks without clinical GI clearance.
